candidate_rq: strategy construction and risk allocation; does the unchanged sparse Gemma-timing/FinBERT-ranking rule transfer to an earlier, non-overlapping LSEG period?

role_and_claim_boundary.correct_interpretation_if_successful: historical external-time corroboration of a rule selected on a later period

collection.universe_policy: exact same 33 company, RIC, query, and alias records as the frozen sector-33 source; no substitution
collection.source: all entitled English-language LSEG Workspace headlines returned by the frozen RIC queries
collection.partial_batch_use: coverage and integrity monitoring only; no scoring, prices, returns, or strategy inference

pre_return_stage_order: complete and hash the immutable headline collection
normalize and deduplicate by the existing normalized-headline hash without prices
run the frozen Gemma model-drift audit
score the complete unique population with both frozen scorers
construct firm-open signals, strategy dates, counts, and names without loading prices
open prices and returns once only if every preceding gate passes

gemma_model_drift_gate.purpose: fail closed if the hosted scorer no longer supports the exact endpoint event definition used by the frozen strategy
gemma_model_drift_gate.reference_population: successful rows in the completed 888155-headline DeepInfra FP8 LSEG score file recorded by the parent spec
gemma_model_drift_gate.endpoint_stratum: all 774 reference rows whose signed score is exactly +1.0 or -1.0
gemma_model_drift_gate.nonendpoint_stratum: 1000 non-endpoint hashes with the smallest SHA256 of '20260806:' plus normalized_headline_sha256
gemma_model_drift_gate.scoring_contract: exact parent Gemma model, provider, FP8 quantization, prompt, temperature, no-fallback, schema, and privacy contract
gemma_model_drift_gate.failure_action: report scorer non-comparability and stop before scoring the new population or opening returns; do not redefine the trigger

minimum_signal_population.chronological_halves: split the available complete session sequence into equal ordered halves, assigning the extra session to the second half
minimum_signal_population.rule_if_not_met: stop without performance inference; preserve the scored historical population as a measurement result

one_shot_return_replay.primary: inherit the parent equal-weight Gemma-timing/FinBERT-ranking strategy and every portfolio, cost, inference, factor, half-stability, and leave-out gate unchanged
reporting: gross and net mean return per complete calendar session
turnover, maximum drawdown, break-even cost, and exposure
chronological halves and rebuilt leave-one-company and leave-one-sector-out results
one_shot_return_replay.primary_promotion_rule: the inherited conjunctive parent gates; no threshold or strategy selection after returns are opened

secondary_mechanism_family.multiplicity: Benjamini-Hochberg over the two mechanism p-values
tests: all non-zero circular shifts of the complete Gemma event/count schedule while FinBERT ranking, cap, horizon, and costs remain unchanged
same-session matched-count random-name assignments within the eligible frozen universe while Gemma dates/counts, cap, horizon, and costs remain unchanged
secondary_mechanism_family.interpretation: diagnose whether any return result is specific to event timing and name ranking; these tests cannot rescue a failed primary gate

authorisation_boundaries.required_before_paid_scoring: explicit user approval of the incremental spend and licensed-headline transmission under the existing privacy controls

known_limitations: The backward interval is earlier than the strategy-selection window but was proposed after that window was inspected, so it is stronger than another same-window test and weaker than a true prospective test.
The OpenRouter model identifier and provider pin do not cryptographically pin hosted model weights; the predeclared drift gate reduces but cannot eliminate this risk.
Exact +1/-1 endpoints are unusually calibration-sensitive, so drift-gate failure is a substantive measurement result rather than permission to tune a new endpoint.
LSEG archive coverage and metadata may differ from recent Workspace coverage even under identical queries.
Raw next-open price returns exclude dividends and do not establish intraday availability beyond the conservative parent timing rule.
